integrity: Standalone symbolic and numerical checker supplied; finite checks support, but do not replace, the proof. No independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Only exchange-symmetric positive prime-two orbits and strict two-step linear attraction. Nonhyperbolic equality and nonexchange cycles not classified. Substantial unresolved priority risk from the inaccessible full text of Jiang and Rogers (1987).
title: Sharp competition ceiling for attracting exchange cycles in the symmetric Ricker map
